summary: Retest for BUG1 (no login/register error message) and BUG2 (broken CSV export -> now real .xlsx) fixes, plus full regression of the pre-existing backend/browser suites. All artifacts pass. 5 backend test files (15 tests, incl. rewritten backup suite for the xlsx migration) + 24 browser checks (2 newly named: backup-card-hidden-for-kasir; backup-download-buttons-trigger-files updated to expect .xlsx filenames instead of the old broken .csv). One pre-existing check (product-form-field-visibility-by-type) failed once on a 429 rate-limit from concurrent parallel logins and passed clean on immediate rerun -> classified flaky, not a bug. No new bugs found.
action_items: product-form-field-visibility-by-type hit a 429 (rate limit) on the demo-login button when run concurrently with several other checks hitting /auth/login at once; passed cleanly on solo rerun. Not a bug in the app, but worth noting if this suite is ever run fully in parallel again.

checks.criterion: Pesan salah saat login dengan password salah / email tidak terdaftar / field kosong (BUG 1 fix)
checks.name: login-shows-error-banner-and-toast
checks.evidence: Wrong password -> login-error-message visible with text 'Email atau password salah', stays on /login. Unregistered email -> same message. Empty fields -> 'Email dan password wajib diisi', no server round trip attempted before that message (401s in console are from the two deliberate wrong-credential submits, not the empty-field case).

checks.criterion: Pesan error saat mendaftar dengan email sudah dipakai / password < 6 karakter (BUG 1 fix, register tab)
checks.name: register-shows-error-banner-and-toast
checks.evidence: Password 'abc' -> register-error-message 'Password minimal 6 karakter'. Duplicate email pemilik@demo.id -> register-error-message text 'Email sudah terdaftar. Silakan login.' (backend 409 surfaced, not silent), form stayed open both times.

checks.criterion: Login yang benar tetap berhasil, banner hilang, toast sukses
checks.name: login-success-redirects-to-kasir
checks.evidence: After a deliberate wrong-password error (banner visible), correct password -> 'Berhasil masuk' toast, redirected off /login, login-error-message count back to 0.

checks.criterion: Unduh Stok IMEI / Produk / Transaksi (Excel) dan Cadangan Lengkap (JSON) dari /users (BUG 2 fix)
checks.name: backup-download-buttons-trigger-files
checks.evidence: Downloads captured: kasirku-backup-2026-09-25.json, kasirku-products-2026-09-25.xlsx, kasirku-units-2026-09-25.xlsx, kasirku-transactions-2026-09-25.xlsx (updated from the old, now-removed .csv expectation); each followed by a 'berhasil diunduh' toast.

checks.criterion: Excel export content: sheet 'Stok IMEI'/'Produk'/'Transaksi', header Indonesia, kolom terpisah, harga bertipe angka (BUG 2 regression)
checks.name: test_tscheck_backup.py
checks.evidence: GET /backup/xlsx/units -> 200, content-type spreadsheetml, filename kasirku-units-YYYY-MM-DD.xlsx; openpyxl-parsed sheet 'Stok IMEI' header == [Nama Produk, IMEI, Warna, Kapasitas, Status, Harga Modal, Harga Jual, Tanggal Masuk, Tanggal Terjual]; fixture IMEI row: Status='Tersedia' in its own cell, Harga Jual=1500000 as a real number. GET /backup/xlsx/products and /backup/xlsx/transactions -> 200 with matching Indonesian headers and sheet names 'Produk'/'Transaksi'. GET /backup/export -> 200 JSON with counts consistent. 4/4 passed.

checks.criterion: Proteksi ekspor: kasir 403 + kartu Backup tidak tampil; tanpa token 401; dataset tak dikenal 404; rute lama /api/backup/csv/units 404
checks.name: test_tscheck_backup.py (test_backup_unknown_dataset_404_kasir_forbidden_403_no_token_401_old_csv_route_404)
checks.evidence: GET /backup/xlsx/not-a-real-dataset (owner) -> 404. GET /backup/export and /backup/xlsx/units as kasir -> 403 each. GET /backup/xlsx/units with no Authorization header -> 401. GET /backup/csv/units (owner, old removed route) -> 404, confirming the dead route stays dead.
